Here is a transcription of the historical marriage registry document from image_4b125f.png.

The record is written primarily in Latin (with some English in the opening entries), which was standard for Catholic parish registers of this era. Abbreviations like *Matrimoniu. inierunt* (entered into marriage), *Coram* (in the presence of/witnesses), and *P.P.* (Parish Priest) are used throughout.

---

## Left Page

### Heading

**1861**
**Registry of Marriages** during the Administration of **Rev’d. Edm’d. O'Keane** Appointed Parish Priest of **Knockaney & Patrick's Well** 21st of Dec’r 1860.
Dated Jany. 21st 1861 by
**Edm’d O'Keane P.P.**

---

### January 1861

* **Jany 19** / John Curtin and Honora Sheehan were Married.
* *Witnesses:* Patrick Tuomy & Ann Tuomy — **E. O'K.**


* **" 21** / Thos Hayes and Brigid Linehan were Married.
* *Witnesses:* Michael Hayes & Margt Collins — **E. O'K.**


* **" 23** / Thomas Fitzgerald et Maria O'Brien Matrimo. inierunt.
* *Coram:* Jacobo Ryan & Johanna Ryan — **E. O'K.**


* **" 27** / Gibbon English & Maria Sheehan Matrimo. inierunt.
* *Coram:* Jacobo Healy & Maria Tuomy — **S. Healy**


* **" 29** / Michael Reagan et Johanna Cooke Matrimo. inierunt.
* *Coram:* Gulielmo Reagan et Brigida Gleeson — **E. O'K.**
